summary: Fase 4 pre-check: Anthropic wrapper client (/api/ai/ping) fully verified. 5/5 pytest passed in 6.1s. Real live Anthropic API call succeeded: GET /api/ai/ping (Bearer demo JWT) returned 200 with {'model':'claude-sonnet-5','resposta':'OK'} — genuine Claude Sonnet 5 response (not mock). Auth guard confirmed (401 without token). Static inspection confirmed /app/backend/ai/claude_client.py reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_MODEL exclusively from os.environ, no hardcoded key or model. Regression sanity: /api/ still 200, /api/wallet still 200 for demo user — backend booted cleanly after anthropic SDK install and ai_health router inclusion; no import errors or startup crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: ai/claude_client.py:20 — module-level `claude = ClaudeClient()` instantiation means missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at import time crashes the whole app on startup (KeyError). Consider lazy instantiation (a get_claude() accessor) so a misconfigured env produces a clean 500 on /api/ai/ping only, rather than preventing all endpoints from booting.

routers/ai_health.py:8 — endpoint is auth-protected but has no per-user rate limit; each call costs real Anthropic credit. Before shipping Fase 4 (checks 9-14), add a per-user cooldown or wallet debit on this route (or gate it behind a debug flag) to avoid an authenticated user burning credit via a scripted loop.

routers/ai_health.py:11-16 — the /api/ai/ping smoke-test endpoint is fine for now but should be removed or gated behind DEBUG=true before production launch, since it is not a real product feature and exposes an authenticated way to spend the account's Anthropic quota.

ai/claude_client.py:10-17 — generate() is a sync method inside an async FastAPI route (routers/ai_health.py); this blocks the event loop for the duration of the Claude call (can be seconds). For Fase 4's 6 AI checks this will hurt concurrency — switch to anthropic.AsyncAnthropic and `await self.client.messages.create(...)` when building the real judgment pipeline.
